recent_en: INSPACE recently secured a RM34.75 million renovation subcontract through its indirect wholly-owned subsidiary IDPM Builder Sdn. Bhd. The company returned to profit in Q3 FY2026 with a profit before tax of RM0.548 million. It also made an unspecified 'OTHERS' announcement.
